title: SPECTRE modeled on ODESSA

tellings.quote: it's very obviously the organization which was known to Ian Fleming as Odessa.

plain: SPECTRE, the villains' secret organization in Ian Fleming's James Bond novels, is said to be modeled on ODESSA, a real network that the story ties to the Nazi figures Martin Bormann and Otto Skorzeny after the war ended in 1945. A researcher named Jason Jorjani, who studies claims of a secret Nazi UFO program, tells Michels that SPECTRE is 'very obviously the organization which was known to Ian Fleming as Odessa.' If so, Fleming, who would have heard about it, put a real surviving Nazi network into popular fiction.
